verdict.rationale: Mastra ships an official first-party MCP server package (`@mastra/mcp-docs-server`) that agents can connect to for documentation access, explicitly documented as compatible with Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Claude Code, VS Code, and Codex, and Mastra also supports authoring MCP servers to expose agents/tools. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of connecting via this MCP server, and no mention of broader MCP server capabilities beyond the docs server.
